summary: The brew time could be stepped below zero and without limit. It is now kept between 1 and 15 minutes, and the minus and plus buttons grey out at the limits.
The buttons also moved from flat grey boxes to rounded white pills, and Start became a solid green bar. The screenshot shows the default state.

focus.title: Clamp replaces the unchecked add
focus.why: Math.min(MAX, Math.max(MIN, ...)) keeps the value in range. Check that the initial 4 and both limits (1 and 15) behave when the buttons are tapped quickly.

focus.title: Disabled state is set only inside change()
focus.why: On first load neither button is disabled, which is correct for 4. If the starting value ever becomes 1 or 15 the buttons would be wrong until the first tap.

skim: style.css only restyles the buttons; index.html is unchanged.
